name: singlet_multimodal_adt_background_removal_normalization
title: ADT background removal and normalization
description: Normalises or denoises droplet ADT (antibody-derived tag) UMI counts so that protein values are comparable across cells. Methods: clr, dsb (empty-droplet standardisation with a per-cell background), decontpro (Poisson ambient and background model) and totalvi (joint RNA and protein model); the default auto picks dsb when empty-droplet counts and an isotype control exist, otherwise clr. It reads layers/counts of the protein modality, writes the corrected matrix to X and method-specific members, and never changes layers/counts. Use it before ADT clustering, embedding, positivity calling or joint RNA-protein analysis; do not use it for RNA counts, for positive or negative calls (multimodal.adt_positivity_calling) or for ambient RNA removal (ambient.count_removal).

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle with the protein modality.

layer.description: Layer holding raw integer ADT UMI counts of called cells (cells by proteins) on the protein modality.

method.description: auto uses dsb when empty-droplet counts and an isotype control exist, otherwise clr. totalvi needs paired RNA counts; decontpro needs cell-type labels.

empty_droplets.description: Member holding the empty-droplet ADT matrix (barcodes by proteins, same protein order). Required by dsb; optional for decontpro; unused by clr and totalvi.

flavor.description: seurat: log1p over the cell geometric mean, zeros stay zero. stoeckius: pseudocount 1, dense output.

axis.description: 1 normalises each cell across proteins. 0 normalises each protein across cells, so values depend on the cohort.

pseudocount.description: Pseudocount added inside the logarithms of step I.

denoise_counts.description: true applies step II (per-cell background and regression); false stops after step I.

isotype_controls.description: Isotype control names used as covariates. null uses var/is_isotype flags; an empty list disables the covariate. Unmatched names are skipped and reported.

scale_factor.description: standardize divides step I by the empty-droplet standard deviation; mean_subtract only centres.

quantile_clip.description: Lower and upper output quantiles for clipping, lower below upper. null disables clipping; (0.001, 0.9995) is the muon setting.

n_latent.description: Latent dimension of the joint RNA and protein model.

batch_key.description: obs column with batch labels used as the batch covariate. null fits one batch.

empirical_background_prior.description: null initialises the protein background prior empirically when more than 10 proteins exist; false uses random initialisation.

include_protein_background.description: false writes the foreground expectation; true adds the background term pi times beta.

cell_type_key.description: obs column with cell-type labels defining the native profiles. Required for decontpro.

delta_sd.description: Scale of the half-normal prior on the standard deviation of the ambient fractions.

background_sd.description: Scale of the half-normal prior on the standard deviation of the background fractions.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Random seed for dsb mixture initialisation and the totalvi and decontpro fits. Ignored by clr.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without computing the normalisation.

overwrite.description: Replace existing X and other output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. X and obs/adt_background_mean. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Compact summary for completed calls with keys method_requested, method_used, n_cells, n_proteins, n_empty_droplets, isotype_controls_used, background_mean_quantiles (dsb), ambient_fraction_median (decontpro), isotype_background_rho (dsb; null if none remain) and flags. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
